integrity: The primary PDF was inspected at the fixed proposition vocabulary and initial state in Section 3.1, the PCP-dependent add_i actions in Section 3.2, the fixed action-set wrapper and goal in Section 3.3, and Theorem 3.19. The Sigma-zero-one upper bound is independently proved by effective enumeration of finite plans.
scientific_limitations: The action library remains part of the input and is not bounded in cardinality or total event-model size. The result is for single-agent K semantics, does not cover the negative-introspection cases that are decidable, and makes no minimality claim for the ten-proposition vocabulary.
title: Fixed-state epistemic planning is Sigma-zero-one complete
